nodes.rationale: Tracked-object detail surface: generativeAI descriptions with regenerateFromSnapshot / regenerateFromThumbnails, sub-label and license plate editing, estimatedSpeed, objectLifecycle carousel with createObjectMask and autoTracking tips, itemMenu actions (findSimilar, submitToPlus, addTrigger, audioTranscription), and exploreIsUnavailable states tied to embeddings reindexing and model downloads.
